subject: science
domain: From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes
cluster: How plants get the materials to grow
skillName: Plants Get Materials from Air and Water

items.prompt:
Plants get most of the material they need to grow from
A) soil only
B) air and water
C) rocks
D) animals

steps: Most of a plant's growth material comes from air and water.

items.prompt:
Which gas from the air do plants take in to help them grow?
A) Oxygen
B) Carbon dioxide
C) Helium
D) Nitrogen only

steps: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.

items.prompt:
Do plants get most of their growth material from the soil?
A) Yes, all of it
B) No, mostly from air and water
C) Yes, half from soil
D) No, from sunlight only
items.answer: B) No, mostly from air and water

steps: Soil gives only small amounts; air and water give most.

items.prompt:
A plant uses sunlight to
A) stay cool
B) provide energy to make food from air and water
C) eat soil
D) make noise
items.answer: B) provide energy to make food from air and water

steps: Sunlight energy powers food-making from air and water.

items.prompt:
A tree gains 40 pounds while its soil loses a few ounces. This is evidence that the tree's mass came mostly from
A) the soil
B) air and water
C) the pot
D) the Sun's matter

steps: Because the soil barely changed, the mass came from air and water.

items.prompt:
A plant kept in total darkness with air and water will
A) grow faster
B) not grow well because it cannot make food
C) turn into an animal
D) grow only at night
items.answer: B) not grow well because it cannot make food

steps: Without sunlight it cannot make food from air and water.

items.prompt:
Which statement is the strongest, best-supported claim?
A) Plants eat soil to grow
B) Plants grow only from sunlight
C) Plants build their bodies mostly from air and water
D) Plants need nothing to grow
items.answer: C) Plants build their bodies mostly from air and water

steps: Evidence from plant and soil weights supports air and water as the main source.

items.prompt:
The best experiment to support 'plants grow mostly from air and water' is to
A) weigh only the plant
B) compare the plant's weight gain to the soil's small weight change
C) count the leaves
D) measure the Sun
items.answer: B) compare the plant's weight gain to the soil's small weight change

steps: A large plant gain with little soil loss shows the material came from air and water.
